shared_elements: procession/frieze of figures on a horizontal band
bearded male head with elaborate coiffure
raised or extended arm holding an object
figures walking to one side, feet in profile
low relief carving of human figures
justification: Both surfaces depict bearded male figures in strict profile, striding in long fringed robes with an arm raised and holding an object, carved in low relief as a continuous horizontal register — a fairly specific shared scheme of processional profile figures. The biggest difference in content is that B shows a single large winged figure with multi-tiered wings and a bucket-like handled vessel, whereas A shows a repeated file of many small wingless attendants without wings or such attributes.
